attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); user-supplied Naver aerial screenshots used for visual reference.
assumptions: Educational model, not a surveyed digital twin. Existing Toegyewon mainline/loops retained.
Elevation levels: surface 0 m, Geumgang-ro 8 m, outer collector bridges 16 m. Layer order follows OSM; numeric heights are model assumptions.
Donggureung-ro modeled with two through lanes and auxiliary turning/merging lanes. Unspecified lane counts are assumed.
Western collector modeled as two lanes despite some OSM sections tagged three; matching the four-lane upstream split avoids overlapping lane groups.
Both collector streams exit through a short synthetic northwest boundary buffer; their farther motorway connection is outside scope.
Partial interchange: six observed turns, north/south through movements, and northwest collector exits; unobserved turns are not invented.
One compact surface priority junction has contPos=0 for its northbound left turn, preserving conflict/yield rules without an internal waiting position.
14,420 veh/hour is synthetic demonstration demand, not measured counts. Existing east/west arterial demand is redistributed among new exits.
All trees and buildings are illustrative visual decoration; no additional traffic dynamics.
The north-side local crossing uses a custom 28 x 32 m intersection envelope so stop lines stay outside conflicting lanes; its exact polygon is a modeling adjustment.
